title: Algorithmic Aspects of the Fermi--Hubbard Model
summary: Preparing Gibbs states on a quantum computer offers a way to computationally probe how microscopic interactions give rise to macroscopic phenomena at finite temperature. However, an uncomfortable tension has set in: our strongest general guarantees for Gibbs state preparation hold in regimes where the resulting states can also be simulated classically. We propose investigating physical models with competing energy scales.
